title: The model prompts of the read steps open with one line naming the CMS of the kit; a kit with no known platform fails before any model call
steps: S1: From the repo root run node --test --test-reporter=tap apps/tracy-web/test/cms-line.test.mjs.
S2: Read the TAP lines for the named tests.
expect: A WordPress kit gets the WordPress line and a Joomla kit the Joomla line.
The line goes first and the locked prompt follows byte for byte.
A kit without a known platform fails loudly instead of guessing.

tests: a WordPress kit gets the WordPress line
the line goes first and the locked prompt follows byte for byte
a kit without a known platform fails loudly
